home.subtitle: Five community cards. One mystery footballer who played with all of them, revealed in the order they crossed paths. Bet your chips on how sure you are — then guess.

rules.title: Rules
rules.puzzleBody: Each round the server secretly picks a Mystery Player and shows five other footballers — the "community cards" — who really played alongside them at some club or national team.
rules.streetsBody: Pre-flop (1 card up), Flop (+2), Turn (+1), River (+1) — a check/call/raise/fold round between each stage, poker-style. All five community cards are up by the River.
rules.guessBody: Submit — or change — your secret guess at any point once betting starts. It's never locked in until the reveal, and nobody else can see what you picked, only that you've picked something.
rules.showdownBody: Once every non-folded player has guessed (or the showdown timer runs out), the Mystery Player is revealed. You don't have to name them exactly — whoever's guess played alongside the most of the 5 community cards wins the pot. Ties split it; if every guess links to none of them, the pot carries over to the next round.
rules.matchBody: Chips carry over from round to round. The match ends once the agreed number of rounds is played, or as soon as only one player still has chips.

guess.title: Who's the mystery player?
guess.hint: Your pick stays hidden from everyone else — you can change it as often as you like until the reveal.
